name: Shadow City Mysteries: Case Files - Rise of the Rat King
source:
Assume the role of the Rat King, an underworld mastermind fighting for absolute power. Shape your legend by forging alliances, crushing rivals, and leaving a trail of consequences. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496430/Shadow_City_Mysteries_Case_Files__Rise_of_the_Rat_King/]Steam[/url]]

扮演鼠王，一个争夺绝对权力的黑道幕后首脑。结交盟友，击垮对手，一路留下你所作所为的后果，写下自己的传奇。
